name: Advance Growmax Topical Solution (60ml)
subtitle: No side effects | Clinically Tested
metaDescription: Dual-action topical formula with minoxidil and finasteride to target hair loss and promote healthy regrowth.

ingredients.name: 5% Minoxidil
ingredients.shortDesc: Minoxidil stimulates hair growth by widening blood vessels & delivering more oxygen-rich blood to the hair follicles
ingredients.longDesc: Minoxidil stimulates hair growth by widening blood vessels & delivering more oxygen-rich blood to the hair follicles. It increases the size of hair follicles for strong & thick hair growth.

ingredients.name: DHT Blocker
ingredients.shortDesc: DHT Blocker blocks the enzymes that convert testosterone into DHT.
ingredients.longDesc: DHT Blocker blocks the enzymes that convert testosterone into DHT. It prevents DHT accumulation at hair follicles and reduces DHT-induced hair thinning. In doing so, DHT Blockers promote hair growth (called the anagen phase).

howToUse: Insert the spray applicator in the bottle. Screw it tightly & remove the safety clip. Aim the pump towards the affected areas of your scalp. Spray the pump once and spread the solution with your fingers. Insert the dropper applicator in the bottle. Fill the dropper up to the 1ml line. Pour the contents of the dropper on the affected area of your scalp. Spread evenly with your fingertips.

faqs.question: How long should I use Minoxifin for men to see results?
faqs.answer: Designed for long-term benefits, Minoxifin are typically used for at least 3 months to see effective results. Use them consistently as directed.

faqs.question: What are the side effects of Minoxifin for Men?
faqs.answer: The Minoxifin solution is specially formulated for men experiencing acute hair thinning, androgenetic alopecia, or male pattern baldness. It is designed to address these concerns effectively with consistent use.

faqs.question: What else can I use with Minoxifin solution?
faqs.answer: You can use Man Matters' Hair Anti-flakes shampoo for men to clean your scalp before applying the Minoxifin solution for men. You can use a derma roller for your hair to increase the absorption and see the best results of Minoxifin solution for men. To nourish and strengthen your hair, you can have biotin supplements to meet your daily biotin nutritional requirements.

faqs.question: Who can use Man Matters Minoxifin solution for Men?
faqs.answer: Minoxifin solution is formulated specially for men who are facing acute hair thinning, androgenetic alopecia, or male pattern baldness.

faqs.question: How often should I use Minoxifin solution for Men?
faqs.answer: Use the Minoxifin solution for men with the provided spray or dropper applicator, depending on your preference. Apply it consistently for the best results.

faqs.question: Is Minoxidil with Procapil better than Minoxidil alone?
faqs.answer: The choice depends on your hair thinning and the degree of balding. Minoxidil helps grow new hair thicker and faster, while DHT blockers help prevent DHT accumulation to stop hair thinning. Procapil strengthens existing hair follicles to prevent further hair thinning.

faqs.question: Will Minoxifin help with growing my beard?
faqs.answer: As per medical guidelines, Minoxidil can only be prescribed for hair on your scalp. However, there has been anecdotal evidence suggesting its effectiveness on beard as well. It contains a DHT blocker which is beneficial for hair on the scalp and not for beard.

faqs.question: Can the product be used after a hair transplant?
faqs.answer: Yes, in most cases, Minoxifin can be used to maintain hair after a hair transplant. However, the suitability may vary depending on the individual case.

faqs.question: Will using this product cause itching or oiliness in the scalp?
faqs.answer: Initially, it's normal to notice slight irritation, and increased sebum production.

faqs.question: Is it normal for the tonic to change colour?
faqs.answer: It is natural for Minoxidil to change colour with time. This results in no change in efficacy, so it's perfectly fine to continue using it.

faqs.question: How should I use Minoxidil with a Derma Roller?
faqs.answer: To use Minoxidil with a derma roller, gently roll it over the affected areas once a week, then apply Minoxidil.

faqs.question: Can I apply minoxidil on my scalp after derma rolling? Do I need to wait 8-24 hours?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can apply Minoxidil after derma rolling, but it's best to wait for about 30 minutes to an hour before applying. This allows your skin to calm down and minimizes irritation. There's no need to wait 8-24 hours, but immediate application can cause discomfort or increased sensitivity.
